basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why property and health claims take too long to settle and where the time is lost.

gate.label: Diagnostic readout
gate.decision: Do the findings explain the delays well enough to set the focus of the design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model for property and health and the roadmap to move to it.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Are the recommendations ready to go to the Board?

workstreams.name: Claims handling flow
workstreams.answers: Where in the handling of property and health claims does time accumulate before settlement?
activities: Map the property and health claims process step by step
Analyze operational data on handling times by step
Review claims documents and files on delayed cases

workstreams.name: Claims pain points
workstreams.answers: What do claims handlers, the COO, the Head of Claims and customers see as the causes of delay?
activities: Interview claims handlers in property and health
Interview the COO and Head of Claims on causes of delay
Collect customer feedback on slow claims

workstreams.name: Delay causes and baseline
workstreams.answers: What are today's settlement time and customer satisfaction, and which causes of delay matter most?
activities: Measure settlement time and satisfaction by claim type
Review what the 2024 lean program changed for motor claims
Rank the causes of delay by effect on settlement time

workstreams.name: Operating model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could settle property and health claims faster without lowering satisfaction?
activities: Define options for organizing property and health claims
Assess each option against settlement time and satisfaction
Check each option fits the current claims IT system

workstreams.name: Detailed model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen claims operating model work day to day, and how is it measured?
activities: Detail processes, roles and decision rights of the model
Agree measures for settlement time and satisfaction

workstreams.name: Roadmap and recommendations
workstreams.answers: What steps lead from today's claims handling to the chosen model, and what goes to the Board?
activities: Sequence the steps to move to the chosen model
Draft the written report with findings and recommendations

deliverables.name: Claims process baseline for property and health
Interview synthesis of claims pain points
Prioritized causes of delay in settlement
Claims operating model options for property and health
Agreed measures for settlement time and satisfaction
Detailed design of the chosen claims operating model
Transition roadmap for the chosen operating model
Written report and board presentation of recommendations

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, plan and data access
events.decision: Is the scope and plan for the engagement confirmed?
agenda: Present the engagement plan and the governing question
Confirm the scope, including what is out of scope
Align on access to claims data and people

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review first findings on the causes of delay
events.decision: Which causes of delay should the remaining diagnostic work focus on?
agenda: Present the claims process baseline and interview synthesis
Review the settlement time and satisfaction baseline
Decide where the remaining work should focus

events.label: Diagnostic readout
events.purpose: Close the diagnostic and set design focus
events.decision: Do the findings explain the delays well enough to set the focus of the design?
agenda: Present the prioritized causes of delay
Review the findings against the governing question
Decide the focus of the design phase

events.label: Workshop: model options
events.purpose: Review the options and choose one to detail
events.decision: Which claims operating model option goes forward to detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options
Review the proposed measures for settlement time and satisfaction
Decide which option goes forward to detailed design

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review the report and prepare the Board
events.decision: Are the recommendations ready to go to the Board?
agenda: Present the written report and board presentation
Review the detailed design and transition roadmap
Decide whether the recommendations go to the Board

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; phase lengths of 6-8 and 8-10 weeks are estimates from typical weeks, fitting the 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new supervisor guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Implementation of the new model and replacement of the claims IT system are not in these phases; the plan ends with the transition roadmap.
